describes: packages/plugin/attachment: the on-demand attachments mirror joined with the pages' file attachment annotations, the selection, adds and removes through doc.apply, downloads, and the optional annotation and stage plugins.

cases.name: empty-until-loaded
cases.covers: controller.ts:92-108 on-demand mirror: every read is empty and the status idle until ensureLoaded asks; loading while the read is out; the read lands in name-tree order as AttachedFiles (model.ts:41-44, id doc:<key>, home document) and fires onResynced, no onChanged; get by id, null for an id the list lacks; isPending (controller.ts:141-145) is true for an attachment before the first read lands and false once it is confirmed; a second ensureLoaded resolves at once

cases.name: a-failed-read-reads-again
cases.covers: controller.ts:288-289 ensureLoaded and refresh: a failed read rejects, the status is error and the next ensureLoaded reads again; refresh reads again and fires onResynced with the new list and no onChanged; a refresh during a read joins it and reads once more

cases.name: a-forbidden-read
cases.covers: the mirror status is forbidden for a permission-denied read; the list stays empty and the selection keeps nothing

cases.name: both-homes-in-one-list
cases.covers: controller.ts:114-126 list: the attachments in name-tree order, then each file attachment annotation with a file in page order (model.ts:47-54, id page:<annotationKey>, home page, its file info); a square and a file attachment annotation without a file have no row; before the attachments are read the pages' files list alone; an annotation created remotely joins and one deleted leaves; isPending of a page's file is the annotation plugin's; canRemove of a page's file is the annotation plugin's canDelete (false for a locked annotation, controller.ts:293-296), of an attachment canAdd

cases.name: names-and-selection
cases.covers: controller.ts:128-139,285 select and getSelected: the files by id in the order selected, each once, files the list lacks dropped; selecting the same ids leaves the state as it is (model.ts:24-29); [] clears; a file the list loses drops out of getSelected while its id stays selected

cases.name: add-shows-at-once-and-confirms
cases.covers: controller.ts:178-220 add: the files show at once and pending (sync/files.ts:63-77: the name, type and description the op says, the size of its bytes, no checksum or dates), placed by key in UTF-16 order (sync/files.ts:32-39); a name the document has takes the first free number before the extension (model.ts:61-70: notes (3).txt, README (2), .env (2)), and two of one name in one add take two; one apply for the files; a key with a character outside the BMP sorts before U+FF26, as the UTF-16 comparison puts it, pending and confirmed; the confirmed events fire onChanged added with the origin before the promise resolves with the engine's records in order; isPending after

cases.name: add-reads-first-and-checks-names
cases.covers: controller.ts:204-210: an add with no files resolves [] and reads nothing; an add before the first read reads the attachments first, since the names in the document decide the free ones; a file without a name (absent, null or empty) rejects invalid-input once the read landed and stages nothing

$error.message: attachment.add: a file needs a name: pass { data, name } or a File

cases.name: remove-an-attachment
cases.covers: controller.ts:222-243 remove: the file goes at once, one change (label attachment.remove), the confirmed event fires onChanged removed with the file as it was (controller.ts:83-86) before the promise resolves; a key the read list lacks rejects not-found and stages nothing; before the first read lands the engine decides

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: attachment.remove: the document has no attachment 'missing.txt'

cases.name: remote-changes-fold-whoever-made-them
cases.covers: sync/files.ts:48-59 foldFiles and controller.ts:73-90,99-107 onChanged with the event's origin: an event before the first read changes nothing; a remote create joins in key order and fires added; a remote delete fires removed with the file as it was; a delete naming no file or a key the list lacks changes nothing and fires nothing; a restore fires restored; an event of another kind fires nothing

cases.name: undo-shows-the-files-as-they-were
cases.covers: sync/files.ts:98-125 undoOf: undoing a remove shows the file back, in its place, before the engine answers (attachments.restore); undoing an add shows the file gone (attachments.delete); a refused undo drops what it showed; controller.ts:211-213,237-239 the history labels, attachment.remove and attachment.add with the count

cases.name: download-an-attachment
cases.covers: controller.ts:245-265 download: the engine's bytes with the file's name as a person may see it (names.ts:7-15: control and bidi characters gone, trimmed, "attachment" when nothing is left) and its type; a file this session is still adding is read once the change settled; an engine refusal maps to a PluginError

cases.name: page-files-go-through-the-annotation-plugin
cases.covers: controller.ts:222-225,251-254,267-279: removing a page's file deletes its annotation, downloading it reads the annotation's file resource; reveal selects the annotation and brings it into view on the stage, a third down; reveal of an attachment, or of a page's file the annotations lack, does nothing

cases.name: without-the-optional-plugins
cases.covers: controller.ts:110,141-142,169-176,267-279,293-296: with no annotation plugin the list has the attachments alone, a page's file is never pending and cannot be removed, removing or downloading one rejects not-found and reveal does nothing

cases.name: reveal-without-the-stage
cases.covers: controller.ts:267-279: with the annotation plugin and no stage, reveal selects the page file's annotation and moves nothing

cases.name: without-doc-attachments-modify
cases.covers: controller.ts:149-155,291-296: without doc.attachments.modify canAdd and canRemove of an attachment are false, add and remove reject permission-denied before anything is read, staged or written (no attachments.list, no apply); download still works

cases.name: without-doc-download
cases.covers: controller.ts:255,291: without doc.download canDownload is false and downloading an attachment rejects permission-denied without asking the engine, and a page's file is refused by the annotation plugin the same way; adding still works

cases.name: annotation-can-delete
cases.covers: controller.ts:293-296: canRemove of a page's file is the annotation plugin's canDelete, false when the document refuses deleting annotations, while canRemove of an attachment is canAdd

cases.name: an-engine-refusal
cases.covers: controller.ts:157-167 answer: a refused add or remove rejects with the refusal as a PluginError and the view drops what it showed; no onChanged

cases.name: cancellation
cases.covers: controller.ts:149-167,208,257-260: a signal aborted before a call refuses add, remove and download before anything starts; an add aborted while it reads rejects operation-cancelled and stages nothing while the read lands; a write aborted while its answer is on its way rejects and the change still lands; a download aborted while the engine reads aborts that call; ensureLoaded races the signal

cases.name: close
cases.covers: a read on its way when the document closes resolves undefined (the mirror drops an instance-closed load); a write on its way rejects instance-closed; reopening starts idle
